title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
lineage: Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 @ 24 bit 96 kHz
source: dead center 10 rows back with a Sony ECM-22P mic (mono)> Sony TC-55 > BASF C90 master cassettes

ai_review.summary: A rare early‑70s field recording that captures the depth of a classic Dead show despite mono cassette limitations.
ai_review.review: Harry Morgan praises this widely circulated 1973 performance, noting its lasting popularity and strong musical flow even though no specific songs are called out. The recording is a field capture taken close to the PA with primitive mono cassette gear, resulting in noticeable fidelity limits but still delivering surprising richness and ambience for its era.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review; the reviewer is enthusiastic about both the show’s historic value and the recording, but acknowledges technical constraints of early‑70s field cassette gear.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono TC‑55 cassette capture; limited hi‑fi fidelity, tape hiss and sand damage noted, but still offers surprising depth thanks to proximity to the PA and multi‑mic array setup.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not specifically described; reviewer mentions the show is widely circulated and remains popular, implying a solid overall flow.
